# Famidash — NES homebrew game

**Upstream:** https://github.com/tfdsoft/famidash
**Snapshot:** 2026-11-04, release `Demo5` (2024-07-14, tag commit
`a5545c09e01e0ee676f224d91177282f436560df`) — the latest release not marked
pre-release
**License:** MIT (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)) — © 2023-2024 Team Famidash
**Taken:** the release asset `famidash.nes` (786448 bytes, sha256
`128910cf18ed312d9623249e32751329cd2696f5f870bbd65cd7ca50cece859d`), NES 2.0 header,
mapper 4 (MMC3), 512 KiB PRG, 256 KiB CHR.
**Not taken:** the source tree — the ROM is built upstream; nothing here rebuilds it.

A demake of Geometry Dash for the NES. Staged as `\games\FAMIDASH.NES`; both emulators
open it (`TRICNES.EXE`/`FAMI.EXE` with the path, or from its tile in the launcher).
